## Summary

What this changes, and which milestone in `docs/design/PHYSICS_ENGINE_PLAN.md` it belongs to.

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run build`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test`, `bun run lint` and `bun run format:check` pass
- [ ] No units, constants or math defined locally; anything missing is a MathTS issue
- [ ] New shapes, joints or integrators are catalog rows, not new per-feature files
- [ ] A changeset for every package whose published surface changes
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private notes

## Testing

How the change was checked.
